⚡ 8 Transformation Priorities

1. Crypto-Agility First

Immediate PQC migration planning. No defence system left vulnerable to quantum decryption. Crypto-agility as standard architecture requirement.

2. Sovereign Quantum Capability

UK must maintain sovereign quantum computing, sensing, and communications capability. No total dependency on allied provision.

3. AUKUS Quantum Advantage

Quantum collaboration as Pillar III accelerator. Trilateral R&D sharing. Joint capability development with IP protection.

4. Threat-Informed Investment

Investment aligned to adversarial quantum timeline. Priority to cryptanalysis defence. Intelligence-led capability prioritisation.

5. Skills Pipeline Security

Quantum workforce as national security priority. Academic-military pipeline. Retention of quantum talent. Diversity in quantum workforce.

6. Supply Chain Sovereignty

Critical quantum components sourced from trusted suppliers. No single-point dependency. Domestic manufacturing where strategic.

7. Ethical Quantum Innovation

Dual-use governance from R&D stage. International norms engagement. Responsible innovation framework.

8. Parliamentary Transparency

Regular quantum strategy progress reports. Investment accountability. International commitment tracking. Independent review.

🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No quantum technology transfer without AUKUS-tier export control verification and IP protection assessment
  • ❌ No PQC migration delayed without documented risk acceptance from CISO and crypto-agency review
  • ❌ No quantum sensing deployment without ethics review for dual-use and privacy implications
  • ❌ No quantum workforce programme without security vetting for cleared quantum research access
  • ❌ No quantum supply chain contract without trusted supplier verification and critical material sourcing audit
  • ❌ No quantum computing application for defence without adversarial threat assessment and proportionality review
